english_text: Mr Gil-Robles ' recommendation , on the contrary , keeps to the path of the past , that of a European Parliament made up of representatives of the Member States instead of the whole European Community . This is regrettable because different peoples of Europe , such as my own , that have been divided by the action of the current Member States , will remain separated in the future . For how long will the French , the Spanish and other such separatists persist in this , may I ask ?
